project: Fine-tune a small classifier to detect toxic comments and report its F1 score on the held-out test set.

agents.task: Turn the training data into cached features and train the classifier.
Turn the test data into cached features and set up the evaluation config.
Evaluate the trained classifier and write the report.

metric: f1
